# ExamHost - Online MCQ Assessment Platform

> Fast, interactive web assessment platform for students and instructors featuring instant grading, real-time timer auto-save, and performance analytics.

## Core Capabilities
- Public exam exploration by Class, Subject, and Chapter
- Student ID authenticated results and mastery tracking
- Real-time exam taking with offline/cloud auto-save protection
- Teacher admin portal with exam authoring, question management, and student analytics

## URL Endpoints
- `/`: Public exam catalog and category browser
- `/my-results`: Student performance analytics and exam scorecards
- `/admin`: Instructor dashboard and exam manager
